named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate has material exposure to the Hurricanes Harvey and Irma in the 2016 and 2017 year of account. This increases the uncertainty of the Syndicate's total reserves, but does not increase that uncertainty in an adverse direction significantly beyond the normal range of uncertainty for insurance liabilities at this stage of development.

data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development triangle (gross amounts) the Syndicate shows a small net adverse prior-year development of approximately 0.816 million (USD) - i.e. a modest strengthening of reserves. The portfolio is predominantly property (fire and other damage to property) and the report highlights material exposure to Hurricanes Harvey and Irma (2017), which increases reserve uncertainty but was not described as causing a materially adverse deterioration beyond normal uncertainty ranges.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (0.816) was not stated explicitly as a gross movement in the notes; it was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 43) using the prescribed diagonal comparison excluding the two most recent underwriting years. Amounts in the report are presented in $'000; all monetary values above are converted to millions. No explicit 'movement in prior year's provision' gross figure was found. Confidence is 0.8 (calculated from stated triangle values).
